messages:
Anna: Heads-up — starting prod deploy v2.4.1 now (change window 02:00-03:00 UTC). Canary -> 10% -> 50% -> 100% per runbook. If p99 latency increases >200ms or errors spike >1.5x sustained for 5m, execute backout. Runbook: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/deploy-backout-v2 (see 'Decision matrix' & 'Pin commands').

deploy-bot: Canary phase initiated on shard a1. Canary targets: 30k rps, 10% traffic. Tracking health metrics.

Derek: Confirming canary kicked off. @Leo @Sai please monitor metrics and logs. I'll keep an eye on traces.

deploy-bot: Canary health update (t+2m): p50 +18ms, p95 +35ms, p99 +42ms, errors 0.4% (baseline 0.35%). Proceeding to 50% in 6m unless flagged.

Leo: Seeing a small uptick in token-generation errors on model-embed worker: 0.4% -> 0.9% over last 1m. Not over threshold yet but flagging.

Sai: Copy. Agree threshold at >1.5x baseline or absolute >1.5% for 5m triggers abort. If we abort, we'll pin back to v2.4.0 and revert routing. Pin command is via ops-bot.

Anna: Quick reminder — rollforward vs rollback: if we can mitigate within 10m by config flip/FF, prefer rollforward. If not, immediate backout. Rollback snippet in case: 

```
# Pin to previous stable version (run from ops runbook session)
ops-bot pin-version --env prod --service model-serving --version v2.4.0
# Abort rollout
deploy-bot abort --thread 2012345678 --reason "errors > threshold"
# Purge edge cache to avoid mixed responses
edgectl purge --prefix /api/v1/generation
```

Derek: If abort happens, also kick the canary-log-collector job and gather the last 10k request traces: `/infra/jobs run canary-log-collector --since 15m`. We want traces before pin completes.

deploy-bot: Rollout progressed to 50% (t+9m). Monitoring continues.

Anna: Decision timeline: between 02:00–02:20 UTC, if we hit errors >1.5x baseline or p99 +200ms for two consecutive 5m windows, we abort. Otherwise continue to 100%. If we abort, who will publish the incident stub? @Derek? :warning:

Leo: Acknowledged. I'll own the triage during window and escalate to oncall SRE if we abort.

Sai: I ran the backout drill this morning; expected time: 2–3m to pin + 4–6m for traffic to converge and caches to clear. Prepare to open #incidents if aborting.

deploy-bot: Rollout to 100% complete (t+18m). Post-deploy smoke: health checks OK on 8/8 hosts, error rate stable at 0.45%.

Anna: Great — no rollback required. Action items: 1) Update release notes with the rollout windows and threshold checks; 2) Add the small error bump to the post-release observations in the release ticket; 3) Schedule a short sync tomorrow to review canary sensitivity. Thanks team :thumbsup:

Derek: I'll file the short follow-up and close the temporary alert.

ops-bot: Note — runbook audit log updated: runbook-id deploy-backout-v2 executed by Anna at 2012345678.

Anna: Closing thread. If anyone sees late regressions, re-open here or ping #incidents.
